const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Recorded controller helpers for the basketball service episode.
+
+The service is the only source of robot state. This file keeps every command
+explicit and makes it easy to resume observation/control without resetting.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+def connect():
+    return Robot()
+
+
+def snapshot(robot=None, cameras=None):
+    robot = robot or connect()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=cameras, video="none")
+    return robot, spec, obs
+
+
+def action_from_rad(spec, q):
+    """Convert 19 joint angles in radians to normalized servo targets."""
+    limits = spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["range_rad"]
+    limits = np.asarray(limits, dtype=float)
+    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
+    return np.clip(2.0 * (q - limits[:, 0]) / (limits[:, 1] - limits[:, 0]) - 1.0, -1.0, 1.0)
+
+
+def hold(robot, target, steps=1, cameras=None, video="none", note=""):
+    target = np.asarray(target, dtype=float).reshape(1, 19)
+    actions = np.repeat(target, int(steps), axis=0)
+    return robot.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=0.02, interpolate="hold",
+                        cameras=cameras, video=video, note=note)
+
+
+def inspect_result(result):
+    return {"meta": result.meta, "proprio": result.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now")}
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    robot, spec, obs = snapshot()
+    print(json.dumps({"status": robot.status(), "spec": spec,
+                      "proprio": obs.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now")}, indent=2))
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
